To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
A noise injection software was used to verify and fine‐ tune a pediatric CT scan technique chart based on patient’s abdominal circumference (AC).
The AC‐based technique chart for pediatric abdomen is verified on a clinical trial and the chart is fine‐tuned using a software to simulate dose‐reduction without rescanning the patients.
the AC‐based technique chart can be fine tuned by a software that “injects” CT noise into projection data to mimic dose reduction.

the development of an effective and reliable technique chart for pediatric abdominal CT.
the development of a new method for the design and optimization of a CT technique for pediatric patients.
developing a new method for optimizing CT scan techniques and reducing radiation exposure to patients.

AC is a very effective and reliable parameter for selection of pediatric abdominal CT scan technique.
